mapper.select: SELECT id, boardTitle, boardWriter, createdAt FROM board_table ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 4
mapper.insert: insert into board_table(boardTitle, boardWriter, boardPass, boardContents, member_id,fileAttached) values(#{boardTitle}, #{boardWriter}, #{boardPass}, #{boardContents}, #{memberId},#{fileAttached})
mapper.select: select id, boardTitle, boardWriter, boardHits, date_format(createdAt, "%Y-%m-%d") as createdAt from board_table order by id desc
mapper.update: update board_table set boardHits=boardHits+1 where id=#{id}
update board_table set boardTitle=#{boardTitle}, boardContents=#{boardContents}, fileAttached=#{fileAttached} where id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into board_file_table(originalFileName, storedFileName, boardId) values (#{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{boardId})
